headline: Brazil's SUSEP proposes LRS reforms, cat bonds, parametrics for catastrophe protection - Artemis.bm
summary: Brazil's insurance regulator SUSEP has published proposals to bolster catastrophe protection, including LRS reforms, catastrophe bonds and parametric products.
why: SUSEP regulates Brazil's private insurance market, and changes to catastrophe coverage rules affect insurers, reinsurers and insurance-linked securities investors.
